title: Kell dolgoznom: kell + Infinitive with a Person

sections.title: Naming who has to do it
sections.content: You already know kell with a plain infinitive, where who's doing it is left to context: be kell csekkolni. Hungarian also lets you mark the person right on the infinitive itself, with an ending that matches nekem, neked, neki: dolgozni becomes dolgoznom ("I have to work"), dolgoznod ("you have to work"), dolgoznia ("he/she has to work"). kell itself still never changes — only the infinitive takes the ending.

items.english: I have to work, I don't have a day off today.
I have to write a report by this afternoon.
Károly has to work overtime today.

sections.content: You can still drop nekem/neked/neki, just like with any possessive suffix — the ending on the infinitive already says who, so Kell dolgoznom on its own is complete and perfectly natural.
